title: O*NET 45-2092.00 — Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
publisher: O*NET OnLine / U.S. Department of Labor Employment and Training Administration
notes: National occupational-source baseline for crop/nursery/greenhouse work. Supports broad task families such as crop records, plant handling, irrigation, crop inspection, postharvest handling and equipment work. It is not cannabis-specific and must not be treated as a cannabis JTA or pesticide/applicator authorization.
